title: A Perfect Story
overview: When Margot flees her own wedding, she is left feeling adrift. Little does she know, it is David and his delightful chaos who can help her find her way.

title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril
overview: Actor Fedi Nuril takes the hot seat as he faces hilarious jokes from a panel of six comedians and celebrities through the “Trilogy of Laughter”.

title: Alkhallat+: The Series
overview: A Saudi anthology series from the creators of the beloved AlKhallat+ universe, now streaming on Netflix. Four standalone stories drop ordinary underdogs — an anxious teen, a clueless security guard, a desperate filmmaker, and a tongue-tied poet — into absurdly chaotic desert situations. Sharp satire, dry humour, and authentic Saudi cultural identity make each episode a wildly entertaining ride.

title: Boo, Bitch
overview: Two senior BFFs make a last-ditch attempt to be seen. But when one of them becomes a ghost, she'll need to really live her best life — while she can.

title: Cindy la Regia: The High School Years
overview: Cindy, a sharp and restless teenager, grows up happily in the high society of San Pedro Garza García in Nuevo León. When she and her longtime friends enter coeducational high school for the first time, Cindy questions the role of "princess" and the search for "prince charming" she's always been taught. In her freshman adventures, Cindy learns that pleasing others doesn't matter as much as finding herself.

title: Club de Cuervos Presents: The Ballad of Hugo Sánchez
overview: Chava Iglesias's doting personal assistant Hugo Sánchez is tasked with leading Club de Cuervos to victory in Nicaragua -- if only his mom will let him.

title: Crashing Eid
overview: When Razan's British Pakistani fiance crashes her Saudi family's Eid celebrations, she attempts to convince them that he is a suitable match.

title: Dad Stop Embarrassing Me!
overview: A single dad and cosmetics brand owner figures out fatherhood on the fly when his strong-minded teen daughter moves in with him.

title: Daniel Sloss: Live Shows
overview: Comedian Daniel Sloss is ready to find the funny in some very dark topics, from the deeply personal to the truly irreverent.

title: Dash & Lily
overview: Opposites attract at Christmas as cynical Dash and sunny Lily trade messages and dares in a red notebook they pass back and forth around New York City.

title: Fakes
overview: Teenage best friends Zoe and Becca set out to build their own fake ID empire, but when business starts booming, their life of crime gets way too real.

title: Football Parents
overview: When it comes to their children's amateur football careers, this group of parents has no shame, no chill — and a peculiar sense of team spirit.

title: Free Bert
overview: A gloriously messy dad and his equally unfiltered family cause chaos when they try to fit in with the snobby crowd at their elite new school.

title: God's Favorite Idiot
overview: Clark Thompson, a midlevel tech-support employee, finds love with co-worker Amily Luck at exactly the same time he becomes the unwitting messenger of God. Also, there's rollerskating, a lake of fire and an impending apocalypse.

title: I Am Not Okay with This
overview: Angsty Syd navigates high school awkwardness, family drama and an unrequited crush on her best friend while trying to rein in her budding superpowers.

title: Living with Yourself
overview: Burned out on life, Miles undergoes a strange procedure at a strip mall spa -- and wakes to find he's been replaced by a better version of himself.

title: Monkey Wrench
overview: A ragtag crew of mercenaries for hire chases down criminals across the galaxy. They're not the heroes we deserve, but they're the only ones we got.

title: Murderville
overview: Eccentric detective Terry Seattle teams up with clueless celebrity guest stars to investigate a series of murders in this improvisational crime comedy.

title: Neon
overview: Three friends move from a small town in Florida to Miami with the hopes of making it big in reggaeton music.

title: Pretty Smart
overview: A self-proclaimed intellectual, forced to move in with her carefree sister and her sister's lovably eccentric friends.

title: Reporting for Duty
overview: When Suzano assumes the role of police chief at a new precinct, the timid newbie will have to prove his mettle to his fearless squad.

title: Samuel
overview: Samuel is 10 years old. He's keeping a diary, and he has a problem. His problem is that Basile told the tall Julie that Samuel loved her. Which isn't true, he doesn't care about Julie. It's only that she laughed at one of his jokes once and he thought she was nice to do so.

title: Shafted
overview: Four middle-aged male friends fumble their way through love, life and career crises in modern-day Paris — when did being a man become so hard?

title: Sicily Express
overview: With Christmas around the corner, two blundering Sicilian friends working in Milan discover a dumpster that transports them to their families in seconds.

title: Sneakerheads
overview: Family man Devin falls back into his sneaker obsession after his pal Bobby talks him into a wheeling-dealing scheme to score a mythical pair of kicks.

title: Tear Along the Dotted Line
overview: A cartoonist in Rome with his armadillo-for-a-conscience reflects on his path in life and a would-be love as he and his friends travel outside the city.

title: The Chair
overview: At a major university, the first woman of color to become chair tries to meet the dizzying demands and high expectations of a failing English department.

title: The Indian Detective
overview: A Toronto police officer gets involved in a homicide investigation while visiting his father in Mumbai.

title: THE MAGIC PRANK SHOW with Justin Willman
overview: Magician, comedian and expert trickster Justin Willman and his crew pull elaborate pranks on unsuspecting targets to help real people get payback.

title: The Midnight Gospel
overview: Traversing trippy worlds inside his universe simulator, Clancy the space caster explores existential questions about life, death and everything in between.

title: The Pentaverate
overview: After influencing global events for centuries, a secret society faces a dangerous threat from within. Can a Canadian reporter save them — and the world?

title: The Tick
overview: Based on Ben Edlund's cult comic, a mysterious blue avenger teams up with an odd group of superheroes to fight crime.

title: This Is a Gardening Show
overview: Zach Galifianakis digs into the world of gardening, interviewing curious kids and eccentric experts in a funny, oddball celebration of the food we eat.

title: This World Can't Tear Me Down
overview: When an old friend returns to the neighborhood, Zerocalcare wants to help him find his place back in the world. But what's the right thing to do?

title: Time Flies
overview: Fresh out of prison and low on options, two women run a fumigation business — until a shady client pulls them back into the life they fought to escape.

title: Time Hustler
overview: After being hit in the head, a man wakes up in 1927 to discover that he’s the spitting image of a famous bandit — and decides to make the most of it.

title: Trailer Park Boys: Out of the Park: Europe
overview: A lot of liquor an whores, mustard and bologna, maybe some cigarettes and dope, but mostly just liquor and whores, cigarettes and balogna, as well as mustard and dope.

title: Vladimir
overview: When an English professor becomes obsessed with a handsome new colleague, her already complicated marriage and career are thrown into total chaos.

title: Yoh! Christmas
overview: Single, 30 and under pressure, Thando lies to her family that she has a boyfriend. Now she has 24 days to bring one home for Christmas. Can she do it?
